newsitem.title: USA: Providian seeks buyer for insurance units.
newsitem.headline: Providian seeks buyer for insurance units.

text.p: Providian Corp wants to sell its large insurance operations but may have trouble finding a buyer, sources familiar with the situation said on Tuesday.

Providian's various insurance businesses could probably fetch as much as $3 billion, but there are few buyers that could afford such a large sum, industry sources said. But it would be difficult for the company to split the businesses up and sell them separately, they said.
The deal also would have to be structured as a tax-free stock transaction, which would eliminate other potential acquirers, they said. Providian declined comment.
Sources said the Louisville, Kentucky-based insurer hired Goldman Sachs to help it evaluate its options and began exploring a possible sale of the businesses in early November.
One source said Providian had made some presentations to potential bidders and released some financial details.

Potential bidders could include American General Corp, Torchmark Corp, General Electric Co's GE Capital Corp, Aegon NV, Internationale Nederlanden Groep NV, Unitrin Inc and Liberty Mutual, sources said.
American General, Torchmark, Aegon and ING could not be reached immediately for comment. GE Capital and Unitrin declined comment. Liberty Mutual declined immediate comment.
Some companies have already decided not to pursue a deal with Providian, one source said.
And sources said it probably won't be easy for Providian to strike a deal.
"They have a challenge if the businesses are difficult to separate and they need somebody with the ability to do a $3 billion transaction," one source said.
"They may be having some trouble," he said.

Providian's insurance business consists of three main units. One sells life and health insurance through agents to people in their homes. The second sells guaranteed investment contracts and variable annuities. The third sells property-casualty insurance directly to consumers through the mail or by phone.
Providian also has a consumer finance and credit card operation, which has performed strongly. It could become the company's core operation, one source said.
